title: M3.3 Portable Review Handoff implementation
purpose: Implement a deterministic provider-neutral one-case review bundle and fail-closed semantic-review re-entry around the promoted M3.2/M3.2.5 factory.
invariants: M3.2 factory_gate.py, M3.2.5 reliability.py and SourceAdmission remain byte-unchanged upstream authorities.
One review bundle contains exactly one candidate case.

The bundle contains exact candidate, learner brief, FactoryContext, quality report, source catalog, SourceAdmission records, exact source bytes, exact reviewer skill and deterministic REVIEW_REQUEST.md.
Author scratchpad, hidden reasoning, chat logs and active author context have no input surface.
Review bundle identity and ZIP bytes are deterministic and independent of host input paths.
Only exact SourceAdmission PASS records reproducible from the current curated catalog and exact source bytes may be packaged.
Review re-entry requires exact target binding and false/false reviewer independence declarations.
Existing semantic PASS-with-minor behavior is preserved; the handoff layer cannot convert semantic HOLD to PASS.
FactoryRun creation delegates to promoted M3.2.5 reliability authority and self-verifies.
No network, provider API, source ingestion/OCR, learner runtime, Studio UI, automatic publication or repository source corpus is introduced.
M3.4, Gate3, Gate4 and M4+ remain HOLD.
requiredEvidence: Repository governance PASS and PR scope PASS.
Existing M3.2, M3.2.5 and SourceAdmission product tests remain PASS.
Two identical logical inputs at different host paths produce byte-identical review ZIPs.
Exact reviewer skill and deterministic REVIEW_REQUEST.md are included and hash-bound.
Source drift after admission fails closed.
Tampered, duplicate, unsafe or undeclared ZIP members fail closed.
Stale review target and independence violations fail before FactoryRun creation.
PASS review yields a self-verifying PASS FactoryRun.
Justified semantic HOLD yields a self-verifying HOLD FactoryRun.
Minor-only finding preserves existing PASS semantics.
Input candidate, brief, source, admission, handoff and review files remain unmodified.
adversarialTests: Same logical inputs at different physical paths.
independentReview: QA-WP-023 must be disjoint and non-repairing.
Final independent QA must bind the exact frozen ATLAS-WP-019 product head.
At least one real portable PASS handoff and one real portable HOLD handoff are required before promotion.
rollback: Remove the additive handoff module/tests/workflow, restore factory README and remove ATLAS-WP-019 metadata. Promoted M3.2/M3.2.5 authorities and learner runtime remain unchanged.
